About Optimalprint Optimalprint is where Gelato began. What started as a single ecommerce platform has grown into a global brand operating in 20+ markets across Europe, North America, and Australia, helping millions of customers create personalized photo products, cards, prints, and more. We run large, multi-million-euro advertising budgets across a wide portfolio of markets and channels. We move fast, measure everything, and we are rebuilding our customer acquisition engine for the age of AI. That is where you come in. The Opportunity This is not a traditional performance marketing team and we are looking to grow it. We are hiring an AI Marketing Specialist, someone who treats AI not as an occasional tool but as the default operating layer for everything they do, from media buying and analysis to creative production and competitor intelligence. You will own real budgets and real channels from day one, with the mandate and the freedom to automate, experiment, and rethink how acquisition works at a global scale. If you are quantitatively minded, relentlessly curious, and excited by the idea that one sharp operator armed with AI can outperform an entire team using legacy workflows, this role is built for you. You will learn the full mechanics of growing a large, global ecommerce company, work directly with engineering, creative, and data teams, and have a direct line to leadership. We’re an AI-first, cloud-native platform with zero physical assets: - GelatoCreate connects e-commerce businesses to 250+ partners across 32 countries, reaching over 5 billion people in under 72 hours. - GelatoConnect, our AI-driven print production OS, runs producers’ operations end to end, covering procurement, workflow and logistics. - Optimalprint, where Gelato began, is our consumer brand in 20+ markets, helping millions of customers create personalised cards, wall art and gifts, online and through its app. Together they sit between thousands of merchants, our production partners and millions of customers. Every order carries someone’s data, designs and brand. AI at the Core We are not just early adopters of AI — we’re AI-native builders, and security is no exception. - AI is how we work. Engineers use LLMs for code generation, testing and documentation, and autonomous agents drive platform resilience, observability, cost control and internal workflow automation. Our security team works the same way, with LLMs and agents handling alert triage, threat summaries, runbooks and response orchestration. - AI is also what we protect. AI agents already run inside GelatoConnect and our core platform. They map product catalogues, validate file uploads, and even write and deploy integration code. Agents with that kind of reach raise new questions about tool permissions, prompt injection and data flows, and you’ll make sure what they build is secure without slowing our teams down. The Role This isn’t an analyst role where you watch dashboards and send findings back. Our engineers now ship many times more than they used to with AI, so reviewing their work by hand doesn’t scale. You’ll build the agents and automation that review alongside them, make sure the agents engineering builds are secure too, and act as the bridge between information security and engineering. You’ll join a small information security team and work across application security, cloud and identity, and detection and response. You don’t need to be an expert in all of it. GelatoConnect is the operating system that runs print businesses, from the first customer request to the shipped parcel: quoting, order intake, procurement, production and shipping in one connected system. By boosting efficiency and cutting costs, it helps businesses scale to meet market demands. With GelatoConnect, we’re reshaping the print industry to be more efficient, sustainable, and profitable. About the Role GelatoConnect is our B2B SaaS platform for printers and decorators, spanning AI estimating, MIS, print on demand and a full operating system for print businesses. As we rapidly scale, we are sharpening our positioning, monetisation and go-to-market approach to accelerate adoption and long-term recurring revenue growth. We are seeking a commercially driven Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our high-performing GTM team. You will take ownership of Product Marketing initiatives spanning positioning, go-to-market execution, sales enablement and customer advocacy, strengthening and building the capabilities needed to support our growth. Acting as the commercial partner to Product leadership and a key counterpart to Sales, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, equip our commercial teams to win business and represent the voice of the customer. You will have a clear mandate to drive revenue growth, improve product adoption and strengthen our competitive positioning. This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility across the business. We're looking for someone who combines deep B2B SaaS expertise with strong commercial instincts, thrives in a fast-moving environment and is equally comfortable shaping direction and executing the work needed to deliver results.
